title: Commit Phase 4's triage: dha and ~25 promoted ticks exist only as untracked files
body: Every promoted_as id in .ticfac/runs/epic-ncv/findings (nu9, cxk, t5p, 53s, us2, e9n, sz0, aqm, b50, 80x, 4sb, s2n, 2lz, 4g4, v3q, ohs, 2jw, 5px, 9a8), plus dha, 6na, lan, ox0, ufz and w1j, is absent from main, origin/main and epic/ncv, and exists only uncommitted in the operator checkout. The run's records therefore point at ticks no committed tracker contains, and the next epic cannot be run. Commit them, and consider making triage refuse to record promoted_as until the tick is committed.
